1: You find a Drafter camp abandoned in a hurry. One crew member remains, pinned under timber and heavily exposed to the Veil. Conscious but fading, they offer 500gp and a marked route in exchange for passage to the next Hallowstead. Choice: Take them (costs 1 day, 1 Ration/day, risks Veil corruption) or leave them (save supplies, abandon survivor to Hollow transformation).
2: A Drafter crew is pinned by a Hollow clustering. They have Nightwine but no Cobalt weapons. Choice: Help fight (risk safety, waste Munitions) or let them handle it (they may die, you keep resources)?
3: Two Drafter crews arrive at the same Hollow aggregation, both claiming salvage rights. They agree to a "winner-takes-all" duel. Choice: Join the fight (risk injury/death for larger Residuum haul) or negotiate a split (reduce share, avoid combat)?
4: A Drafter runner offers a contract: escort a Residuum shipment through a contested hex. High pay, but the route is known to be dangerous. Choice: Accept (gain Gold/Morale, risk loss) or refuse (keep resources safe, miss profit)?
5: You find a heavily Veil-exposed Drafter, still conscious. They beg for a quick end to avoid becoming a Hollow. Choice: Grant mercy (lose potential ally, gain Morale) or capture for study (gain knowledge, risk Veil corruption)?
6: A Drafter runner offers to trade a rare Cobalt shard for a Nightwine vial. The shard could upgrade your weapons, but Nightwine is scarce. Choice: Trade (gain weapon upgrade, lose survival resource) or refuse (keep Nightwine, miss power)?
7: You encounter survivors from a fallen Hallowstead, sheltered in a nearby ruined watchtower. Terrified of their Omen machine loss and massive franchise debt, they ask you to recover the core from the nearby Hallowstead, now overrun by a Hollow clustering. Choice: Turn back (costs time/Munitions to clear threat, saves them from slavery) or press on (save resources, leave them to fate)?
8: You discover a hidden cache of pristine supplies marked with unknown, jagged symbols. Using them might attract unwanted attention. Choice: Take them (gain resources, risk unknown consequences) or destroy them (deny to enemies, lose resources)?
9: An Omen Beacon flickers, signaling distress from a nearby Hallowstead. Likely a trap, but possibly genuine. Choice: Investigate (risk ambush, potential ally) or ignore (safe, miss intel)?
10: A scavenger crew offers a Munitions cache for a single Nightwine dose. They're just foragers, but have survived longer than most. Choice: Trade (gain Munitions, lose Nightwine) or refuse (keep Nightwine, miss ammo)?
11: A Drafter crew's wagon suffers a collapsed axle on a fractured road. Competent workers, they need a DC 12 Tinker's/Woodcarver's Tools check to repair it, costing the rest of the day. They ask for your expertise. Choice: Help (costs 1 day, yields Residuum/Morale) or refuse (save resources, leave them stranded)?
12: You find a Drafter's last stand, marked by Cobalt shards and Hollow carapace. His logbook requests his body be returned to his family at the nearest Hallowstead for a substantial reward. His Residuum canister is intact. Choice: Honor request (costs 1-2 days, extra Rations, Veil exposure risk, yields Gold/Morale) or harvest Residuum (saves time/resources, forfeits reward, risks Morale penalty)?
13: You discover a Morvane alchemist's abandoned tent. Inside: a locked Residuum canister and a letter to a nearby Hallowstead. It details Morvane's plan to withhold Residuum until Drafters show advanced Veil corruption for "observation." The alchemist stole it and died in the wild. Choice: Return it (costs time/effort, saves settlement) or keep it (gain fuel, condemn settlement, risk faction consequences)?
14: A Drafter scout offers to trade a map to a hidden pre-Sundering supply cache. Found in a hollow tree, he can't verify its authenticity. The route passes through a known Hollow patrol zone. Choice: Trade for map (risk detour/combat for high reward) or refuse (save resources, miss windfall)?
15: A Cobalt shard marks a Kestrel salvage claim. Nearby, a Kestrel Drafter is trapped under a collapsed, sigil-embossed crate. Injured and unable to move it alone, they ask for help. Choice: Help (costs time/resources, gains Morale/Kestrel favor) or leave and take salvage (gain resources, risk Kestrel hostility, lose Morale)?
16: A fringe alchemist offers a tincture distilled from a rare, Veil-tainted herb. It promises to restore expended spell slots, but admits the mixture is unstable and may cause unpredictable side effects. Choice: Purchase/use (gain temporary advantage, risk consequences to the caster) or refuse (play safe, miss resource)?
17: A nearby Hallowstead sends a distress signal requesting volunteers to clear a Hollow clustering threatening their Residuum stores. Choice: Commit crew (costs 1-2 days, consumes Munitions, yields Morale/Residuum/future ally) or decline (save resources, Hallowstead may fall, cutting off trade route)?
18: Drafters know a small, stable Residuum deposit deep in a corrupted zone they can't survive. They offer half the haul if you retrieve it, but you know you could take it all and leave them stranded. Choice: Honor deal (split Residuum, gain loyal ally/Morale) or betray (take all, gain larger reward, lose Morale, burn trade route)?
19: A rival Drafter crew offers a rare potion recipe for a Nightwine vial. Their supply was contaminated, and they're days from turning Hollow. Choice: Trade (lose critical survival resource, save rival crew, gain knowledge) or refuse (keep Nightwine, condemn them, lose recipe)?
20: You find a supply wagon carrying Rations and Munitions. The escort crew is dead, horses killed by a Hollow clustering. Crates are marked for a nearby Hallowstead, but the road is passable. Choice: Carry to Hallowstead (costs time/exertion, secures ally/Morale) or salvage what you can (gain immediate resources, leave Hallowstead short, risk hostility)?
